work_scope.authority_owner: Existing server room, consent and floor checks
work_scope.required_evidence: Failing hook lifecycle cases before fix; passing canonical/export cases; scoped compiler and integration compile
work_scope.explicit_non_goals: No new authority, pairing, session start, provider call or game action

review: The automatic speaking-floor timer now requires a non-null selected room, permits one pending renewal per effect lifetime, and suppresses results after cleanup. It also rejects a response with a different room ID.

Switching rooms, leaving, losing the eligible transport, reconnecting, or unmounting retires the old effect. Successful current responses still update the existing selection and collection; rejected calls can retry on the next ordinary interval.

Six of ten new mounted-hook lifecycle cases fail against the prior hook. Sync, media, debug and visual peripherals are mocked; the actual hook, floor eligibility and room selection functions run. Existing three floor-eligibility tests are retained unchanged.
Reviewed complete unchanged floor eligibility and selection helpers. Their server-authority semantics are unchanged; the new guard governs local asynchronous projection only.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished and uninstalled. Synthetic room responses do not establish real voice, membership, consent, exact pairing or Minecraft handoff.
Already-dispatched server requests are not cancelled or undone by local effect cleanup. Other explicit room actions and poll lifecycles remain separate.
Export tests load the selected hook and two helpers; other dependencies remain canonical.
